speakers.kamala: Kamala, 78, Tamil speaker from Madurai, lives in Chennai. Speaks Tamil; the transcript is Tamil script with the occasional English word (in Latin script) as Tamil speakers really mix them.
speakers.shanti: Shanti, 81, Hindi speaker from Allahabad, lives in Lucknow. Speaks Hindi; the transcript is Devanagari with the occasional English word in Latin script.
speakers.prakash: Prakash, 76, retired railway engineer from Mysore, lives in Bangalore. Speaks Indian English with the odd Hindi or Kannada word.
speakers.sarojini: Sarojini, 82, Malayalam speaker from near Thrissur, Kerala. Speaks Malayalam; the transcript is Malayalam script with the occasional English word in Latin script.
